prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity landscape desktop website direction comp for the VEEMAP homepage, 16:9 first viewport, realistic shippable responsive web UI screenshot, not a poster and not concept art.
Input image: the supplied VEEMAP logo is a brand reference only. Preserve its distinctive nested upward chevron identity using orange and green, integrated into a compact VEEMAP wordmark. Do not copy the white rectangular background or enlarge the logo.
Primary request: Design a premium desktop first viewport titled by its governing interaction, “The Cycle Ledger”. The interface is an edge-to-edge machine-builder kinematic sequence chart. A vertical 0–2.5 second cycle ledger visibly drives a large conceptually accurate, non-proprietary high-speed pick-and-place special-purpose machine that occupies roughly two-thirds of the fold. The selected mechanism phase is unmistakable: one orange phase band in the ledger, an orange motion-path trace through the mechanism, and the corresponding moving head highlighted in orange. The machine must read as a credible automated assembly machine with an anodized cobalt structural frame, brushed aluminium gantry and guarding, graphite linear rails, compact servo pick head, two tooling nests, inspection camera and HMI, shown in an elegant three-quarter orthographic product view. Keep proprietary fine detail abstracted.
Structure and hierarchy: compact navigation across the top; a narrow, clear copy/action rail on the left; the vertical timing ledger immediately beside it, marked clearly from 0.0 s at top to 2.5 s at bottom with five bold major ticks and laser-etched phase traces; the machine dominates the center and right. Fine calibration vellum, coordinate rules and restrained laser-etched timing traces can extend behind the machine, but they must support legibility. The interface should look ready to build in Next.js/WebGL: clean typographic regions, real button affordance, credible alignment, generous negative space, no card grid.
Required visible UI copy, reproduce verbatim with no misspellings and no other words or numeric claims: “VEEMAP”; “SPECIAL PURPOSE. PRECISELY TIMED.”; “Special-purpose machines engineered for speed, accuracy and control.”; “TELL US ABOUT YOUR PROCESS”; “236 PROJECTS DELIVERED”; “AI VISION”; “INDUSTRY 4.0 HMI”; “PREDICTIVE HEALTH”. The three capability labels should be few, clear, uppercase technical callouts anchored directly to the relevant camera, HMI, and machine-health sensor. The 0.0–2.5 s ledger ticks are interface data, not marketing copy.
Visual world: dominant anodized cobalt field #1038C5; brushed aluminium #E9EDF0; graphite #121820; VEEMAP orange #FF982E only for the active phase and primary action; VEEMAP green #15D43A only for confirmed-state pin lights and the green inner brand chevron. Premium industrial editorial art direction, crisp studio-real 3D machine rendering embedded as interactive UI, precise condensed grotesk typography, laser-etched timing traces, translucent calibration vellum, subtle machining grain, disciplined 12-column layout, high contrast and excellent readability. Visually communicate speed, accuracy, sequence control and mechanical intelligence.
Lighting and material: controlled cool engineering-studio light, physically plausible brushed metal, sharp machined edges, subtle cobalt anodization, no glossy sci-fi glow.
Constraints: one complete desktop webpage viewport; mode is Persuade; the visitor must immediately understand VEEMAP builds fast, precise special-purpose machines and know where to enquire. No people. No client logos or client names. No fake certifications, testimonials, benchmarks or extra claims. No proprietary machine detail. No raw CAD screenshot. No bento cards. No generic black-neon technology style. No giant headline covering the machine. No tiny unreadable microtext. No fake browser chrome. No watermark. No extra copy beyond the exact strings and ledger tick values listed above.
